The labels show that A is the lower-left corner, B is the lower-right corner, C is the upper-right corner, and D is the upper-left corner. Reasoning: Let the x-coordinate of the left side of the rectangle be l, and the x-coordinate of the right side be r, then 0<l<r; let the y-coordinate of the lower side be -b, and the y-coordinate of the upper side be -t, then b>t>0. Thus the value corresponding to A is -b/l, the value corresponding to B is -b/r, the value corresponding to C is -t/r, and the value corresponding to D is -t/l. Because A's y-coordinate is more negative and its x-coordinate is smaller, -b/l<-b/r and -b/l<-t/l; also because -b/r<-t/r, A's value is also less than C's value. Therefore the minimum value comes from point A.

raw_record.question_text: The sides of the rectangle $ABCD$ are parallel to the coordinate axes. The rectangle is positioned below the $x$-axis and to the right of the $y$-axis, as shown in the picture. The coordinates of the points $A, B, C, D$ are whole numbers. method.method_draft: Read the diagram as an axis-parallel rectangle in the fourth quadrant, with A the bottom-left corner, B bottom-right, C top-right, and D top-left. Assign variables from the picture: left x-coordinate = l, right x-coordinate = r with 0 < l < r; bottom y-coordinate = -b and top y-coordinate = -t with b > t > 0. Then compute symbolically: A gives -b/l, B gives -b/r, C gives -t/r, D gives -t/l. Because the numerator for A is the more negative y-value and its denominator is the smaller positive x-value, -b/l is less than -b/r and less than -t/l; also -b/r is less than -t/r, so A is less than C as well. Therefore A gives the smallest value.

method.method_draft: Interpret y/x geometrically as the slope of the line from the origin to the point. From the image, all four vertices lie in the fourth quadrant, so all slopes are negative. The smallest value is therefore the most negative, i.e. the ray from the origin that slants downward most steeply. Among the corners, A is both lower than D and C and farther left than B and C, so the line from the origin to A has the greatest downward steepness. Hence A has the smallest y/x value.

再推理：对任一点，(y-coordinate) ÷ (x-coordinate) 就是从原点到该点的直线斜率 y/x。因为四个点都在第四象限，所以 x>0、y<0，四个比值都是负数。最小的值就是最负的值，也就是从原点看向下倾斜最陡的射线。A 点在左侧两点中比 D 更低，所以在相同较小 x 下，A 的 y/x 比 D 更负；A 点又在底边上比 B 更靠左，所以在相同负 y 下，A 的 y/x 比 B 更负。C 既比 B 高又更靠右，不会比 A 更负。因此最小的 y/x 来自点 A。
